text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The crowd bathes the dark-haired conqueror of the year-end Grand Prix with thunderous applause.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I'm truly grateful for everything I have experienced on my journey, expected and otherwise.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Thank you! Thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She bows deeply at the stands, and a fresh wave of applause washes over her, but then…

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: What're you making a big ol' fancy speech for? Are you trying to steal all our thunder?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: And hey, when're you racing next, Flash-idash? You're not planning to run away after nabbing that victory, are you?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Of course I'm not running away.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Komm jetzt, Gold Ship. I welcome your challenge and will happily become an obstacle in your path anytime.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I apologize for the wait, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Now begins the difficult part. I cannot waste any time basking in my victory.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: After all, tomorrow will be the first time I'll wake up with absolutely nothing scheduled for the day.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Additionally, my only directive from now on is to do as I wish, which is an immensely difficult situation to manage.
choice_data_list: Want to call it quits, then?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: It is that difficulty which makes creating a schedule worthwhile.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: What should we decide on first? I can't wait to start!
